name: cpf-enterprise-ecosystem
description: CPF Enterprise Ecosystem — evidence-based, human-reviewed AI-collaboration assessment platform for European enterprise hiring, learning, and workforce intelligence.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cpf/assessment-framework -w @cpf/identity && npm run build -w @cpf/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cpf/assessment-framework -w @cpf/identity && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cpf/assessment-framework -w @cpf/identity && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.api:dev: npm run build -w @cpf/assessment-framework -w @cpf/identity && npm run dev --workspace @cpf/api
